A refitted capture droid?-''"<br />"''Well, now that you mention it, having those things would ''cinch'' the job...|Zee Ethda and Grappa, who then decides to have the former killed|<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 1|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Zee Ethda''' was an alien [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] employed by [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He was given the job of capturing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs officer [[Tarrant Snil]], but failed. He was then given to a group of [[Zanibar]] for their [[Cannibalism|rituals]].
